title: STARTDT activation handshake seed
purpose: Provide a clean U-format entry point for transport/session activation parsing without ASDU ambiguity.
expected_behavior: A 104-capable peer should accept the U-format STARTDT activation and may answer with STARTDT confirmation; parsers should classify both as U-format APCI frames with no ASDU body.
constraints_preserved: Uses only IEC 60870-5-104 APCI framing, avoiding 101/104 hybridization
0x68 length octet equals 4 for U-format frames containing only the control field
Distinct documented U-format control bytes are preserved for activation and confirmation
issue_safety_notes: Benign transport-control analogue only; no historical exploit payloads, no malformed lengths, and no device-specific side effects beyond normal data-transfer start negotiation.
